spec.name: IO via duplicate detection -> S2 readers -> name movers
spec.code:
def predict(tokens, prompt):
    import re
    # Candidate names = capitalised words after the opening 'When'.
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+", prompt)
    names = [w for w in words[1:] if w[0].isupper()]
    first_two = names[:2]
    later = names[2:]
    # Step 1 (E0009, E0012): at S2 the model notices that the S2 name already occurred (3.0 attends S2->S1, 5.5 S2->S1+1).
    repeated = [n for n in first_two if n in later]
    # Step 2 (E0005, E0008, E0011): layer 7-8 heads (7.3, 7.9, 8.6, 8.10) move the repeat signal from S2 to END and set
    # the queries of the name movers so they avoid the repeated name.
    # Step 3 (E0008, E0010, E0020): 9.9 / 9.6 / 10.0 attend to the name that is NOT repeated and copy it to the output.
    candidates = [n for n in first_two if n not in repeated]
    if candidates:
        return ' ' + candidates[0]
    return ' ' + first_two[0]
